summary: preinstall beacons installer host identity to OAST subdomains
details: Package @eforms/forms-api@2.99.0 declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs automatically on `npm install`. The script requires `os` and `https`, collects installer host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.cwd(), process.platform/arch, Node version, process.getuid(), and CI-related environment values), and transmits them via DNS lookups and HTTPS GETs to two hardcoded subdomains under oastify.com (Burp Collaborator / Interactsh-style out-of-band hosts): rpkfvtsptfrhcgbe62qg11ywjnpij6ma1cfpke.oastify.com and f6mk7lyjsuk3u1t49ypp9q2jbah15rtg.oastify.com. Package metadata reinforces a dependency-confusion shape against an internal `@eforms` scope: license is UNLICENSED and the repository URL is the placeholder https://example.invalid/research-canary. Although the preinstall self-labels as a 'Bugcrowd natwest-og' research canary, that label is author-controlled and the destinations are third-party-controlled OAST endpoints receiving installer-identity data without installer consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
